teaser: The pipeline, not whoever pushes, picks the release number: a 2023 scheme now on every site we run.
core_idea: A release number is a fact about the order pushes land, which only the pipeline sees, so CI should pick it. Written for OSBot-Utils on 27 October 2023, the scheme has numbered 1,129 releases of that library and runs sgit and the send app. Agent-built sites relearnt it this week: sharness.ai after three days of collisions, the PHP newsroom's six repositories, and this site after two version races and a refused release. Here the committer builds against a pending version and CI stamps the real one, tags it and deploys that commit; main takes majors by pull request.
